summary.headline: Planetary and Inception Excerpts
summary.text: Excerpts on planetary significations and astrological elections: the Moon as lord of the horoskopos or clime of fortune in the third place, followed by rules for inceptions involving square configurations to the Moon, benefic testimony, the Sun and Moon in masculine and feminine zodiacal signs, and identifications of Hesperos with Aphrodite and Stilbon with Hermes.
